```{ojs}
igvserver = "http://localhost:5497"

igv = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/igv@3.0.2/dist/igv.esm.min.js").then(m => m.default)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
library(readr)

dados <- read_tsv(file = "./data/dados.tsv")

results <- list()
samples <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(dados)) {
  results[[dados[i,]$Filenames]] <- read_tsv(paste0("./altss/", dados[i,]$Filenames, "-pTSS.tsv"))
  samples[[dados[i,]$Filenames]] <- read.csv(paste0("./data/samples/", dados[i,]$Filenames, ".csv"), header = TRUE)
}

# ojs_define(dados = dados)
ojs_define(results = results)
ojs_define(samples = samples)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

fn = species["Filenames"]
sp = species["Species"]
altsstsv = results[fn]
trans = transpose(altsstsv)

toUniprot = function(params) {
    const link = `<a href="https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb?query=${params.value}" target="_blank">${params.value}</a>`;
    
    return link;
}
    
mygrid = {
    document.querySelector("#myGrid").innerHTML = ""
    
    // Grid Options: Contains all of the Data Grid configurations
    const gridOptions = {
      // Data to be displayed
      rowData: trans,
      // Columns to be displayed (Should match rowData properties)
      columnDefs: [
        { field: "Chromossome", width: 150,  headerName: 'Chromosome' },
        { field: "Position",width: 130 },
        { field: "Strand", width: 30 },
        { field: "OriginalFile", width: 130, headerName: 'Library' },
        { field: "Gene", width: 180, headerName: 'Gene' },
        { field: "Protein", width: 180, cellRenderer: toUniprot },
        { field: "Product", width: 420, headerName: 'Function' },
        { field: "TSSCount", width: 140, headerName: 'n(TSS)' },
        { field: "total_ortho", width: 140, headerName: 'n(ortho)'  },
        { field: "memenumsites", width: 140, headerName: 'n(motifs)' },
        { field: "SubClass", width: 90, headerName: 'Subclass'  }
      ],
      // Configurations applied to all columns
      defaultColDef: {
        filter: true,
      //   editable: true,
      },
      // Grid Options & Callbacks
      pagination: true,
      rowSelection: { mode: "singleRow", checkboxes: false, enableClickSelection: true, copySelectedRows: true },
      onSelectionChanged: (event) => {
        // console.log("Row Selection Event!", event);
        if (event.selectedNodes.length == 0) return;
        const lineselected = event.selectedNodes[0].data
        
        const start = parseInt(lineselected[["Position"]]) - 600
        const end = parseInt(lineselected[["Position"]]) + 600
        const locus = `${lineselected[["Chromossome"]]}:${start}-${end}`;
    
        if (typeof igvbrowser != "undefined") {
           igvbrowser.search(locus)
        }
        // console.log(igvbrowser)
      },
      onCellValueChanged: (event) => {
        console.log(`New Cell Value: ${event.value}`);
      },
    };

    const myGridElement = document.querySelector('#myGrid');
    agGrid.createGrid(myGridElement, gridOptions);
}
```

```{ojs}
// defining mytracks
mytracks = (async () => {
  let candidates = [
    {
      name: "Anotação",
      type: "annotation",
      format: "gff3", 
      url: `${igvserver}/data/genomes/${fn}.gff`,
      searchable: true
    },
    {
      name: "TSSAR-pTSSs",
      type: "annotation",
      format: "gtf", 
      url: `${igvserver}/altss/${fn}-pTSS.gtf`,
      searchable: true
    },
    {
      name: "MEME Motif",
      type: "annotation",
      format: "gtf", 
      url: `${igvserver}/altss/${fn}-meme-pTSS.gtf`,
      searchable: true
    },
  ]
  
  // attempts to add samples into mytracks
  // https://igv.org/doc/igvjs/#tracks
  transpose(samples[fn]).forEach(samp => { 
    /* 
    //
    // BAM files are really heavy, but if you want to use them, uncomment this section;
    // Adjust if your study used paired/unpaired libraries as needed.
    //
    // paired
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+`,
      "type": "alignment",
      "format": "BAM",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired.bam`,
      "indexURL": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired.bam.bai`,
    });
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX-`,
      "type": "alignment",
      "format": "BAM",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired.bam`,
      "indexURL": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired.bam.bai`,
    });
    
    // unpaired
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+`,
      "type": "alignment",
      "format": "BAM",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-unpaired.bam`,
      "indexURL": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-unpaired.bam.bai`,
    });
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX-`,
      "type": "alignment",
      "format": "BAM",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-unpaired.bam`,
      "indexURL": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-unpaired.bam.bai`,
    });
    */
    
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ FWD Unpaired`,
      "type": "wig",
      "format": "bedGraph",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-fwd.bedgraph`,
    });
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- FWD Unpaired`,
      "type": "wig",
      "format": "bedGraph",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-fwd.bedgraph`,
    });
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ REV Unpaired`,
      "type": "wig",
      "format": "bedGraph",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-rev.bedgraph`,
    });
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- REV Unpaired`,
      "type": "wig",
      "format": "bedGraph",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-rev.bedgraph`,
    });
  
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ FWD Paired`,
      "type": "wig",
      "format": "bedGraph",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired-fwd.bedgraph`,
    });
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- FWD Paired`,
      "type": "wig",
      "format": "bedGraph",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired-fwd.bedgraph`,
    });
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ REV Paired`,
      "type": "wig",
      "format": "bedGraph",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired-rev.bedgraph`,
    });
    candidates.push({
      "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- REV Paired`,
      "type": "wig",
      "format": "bedGraph",
      "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired-rev.bedgraph`,
    });
  })
  
  // tests if file exists, if it does, append to "results".
  async function urlExists(url) {
    try {
      let res = await fetch(url, { method: 'HEAD' })
      if (res.status === 405 || res.status === 501) {
        res = await fetch(url, { method: 'GET', cache: 'no-store' })
      }
      return res.ok
    } catch (e) {
      return false
    }
  }

  const results = await Promise.all(candidates.map(async t => {
    if (!t.url) return null
    const ok = await urlExists(t.url)
    if (ok) return t
    // console.warn('URL missing:', t.url)
    return null
  }))

  return results.filter(Boolean)
})()
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

igvbrowser = {
  const container = document.querySelector("#igv-container");
  const options = {
    reference: {
      id: `${fn}`,
      name: `${sp}`,
      fastaURL: `${igvserver}/data/genomes/${fn}.fna`,
      indexURL: `${igvserver}/data/genomes/${fn}.fna.fai`
    },
    tracks: mytracks
  };
  
  igv.removeAllBrowsers();

  return igv.createBrowser(container, options);
}
```
